integrity: The proof is self-contained. A same-object preprint was inspected at its chain-graph algorithm, and the three-by-three half graph was checked directly to distinguish the present formula from that routine. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns finite connected chain graphs and determines only the minimum cardinality, not all minimum secure dominating sets. Exhaustive verification is supplementary and stops at total order 10.
title: Exact secure domination number of connected chain graphs
